U.note: Playful stack-to-grid idea with a tilted bento tile layout, but the nav is oddly offset on desktop and the tiles are thin on real function.

V.note: Cohesive Ember & Oak bento with working roast, subscription, bag and collapsible tiles plus a status line and Escape and outside-click close.

W.note: Polished, genuine menu-ordering bento with varied tile sizes, though the size chips on the featured card have weak contrast.

X.note: Compact dark floating nav bar that unfolds into a tight bento with a bag stepper, newsletter signup and Escape hint; tidy and legible.

Y.note: Feature-rich bento (roast, bag, plan, cafes, guides) with a state readout, but the big dark card has dead space and the brand name drops out on mobile.

Z.note: Bold editorial look with an unfolding bento panel, but the panel overlaps and cuts the hero headline and the layout feels cramped.
